name: Awawa Yumemi
source:
"My name is Awawa Yumemi.
And this here is the cute owl that everyone loves, Soncho-sama."

An enigmatic girl who appeared, claiming to be the one in-charge of guiding the Hanamukenogi ceremony. She has an owl named Soncho perched upon her shoulder, whom she greatly reveres, and absolutely adores adores adores adores adores adores adores adores adores adores adores adores adores adores adores adores adores adores adores adores adores adores adores adores adores adores adores adores adores adores adores adores adores adores adores adores above all else.

Flower: Fourwing Evening Primrose

Magic: [???]
